document.title: {symbol} Report
document.subject: Fundamental stock analysis report
context.about_app: {app} is a financial research application created by {author}. It organizes market data, company facts, fundamental analysis and model-based signals into a readable report.
context.report_scope: This report covers {quote_type} {symbol}, {company}, and was generated on {date} at {time}. It brings together the latest available company profile, market session values and analytical indicators.
context.explains: The report explains the security's open, high, low and close values, valuation, growth, profitability, cash flow, financial health, capital allocation and working capital. When available, it also includes dividends, splits, recent news and the model's calculated action signal.
